subject: [RFC PATCH v3 02/14] mm/memcontrol: Refactor page_counter charging in try_charge_memcg

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch refactors the page_counter charging logic in try_charge_memcg to make it easier to distinguish between memcg v1 and v2 cases, in preparation for adding support for a new page_counter toptier. The changes do not introduce any functional differences, but rather simplify the code structure. This is a precursor to further modifications that will enable charging and uncharging of the new page_counter toptier.
